finish_summary: 1) bulk_discount_percent returns 5% for quantity 50 but spec requires 10%. 2) parse_coupon rejects valid codes such as "save20" and "SaVe5", violating case-insensitivity and whitespace handling. 3) remove_item leaves an entry with quantity 0 instead of removing it, contrary to spec that items should be removed when quantity reaches 0 or less. 4) subtotal() incorrectly includes shipping fee (result 85.0 vs expected 25.0). 5) total(member=True,coupon="SAVE10") returns 0 for shipping_fee due to incorrect logic: shipping is free for subtotal >=1000, but after applying coupon discount the subtotal falls below threshold so shipping should still be 30; implementation incorrectly treats shipping based on discounted subtotal leading to wrong result. 6) In total_with_bulk_discount_and_shipping test, subtotal calculation yields 10200.0 instead of expected 12000.0 indicating that bulk discounts are applied in subtotal incorrectly or unit_price not multiplied by quantity properly.
